responses: The tuition fee is ₹50,000 per semester.
You can pay your fees via the student portal using Net Banking or UPI.
Fee payment deadlines are usually by the 10th of every semester month.
Library is open from 9 AM to 9 PM on weekdays.
You can borrow up to 3 books at a time for 14 days.
Library membership is automatic for all students.
You can apply through our online portal on the official website.
Entrance exams are required for BTech and MTech programs.
We offer BTech, MTech, MBA, and MCA programs.
Popular courses include CSE, ECE, Civil, and Data Science.
Full course list is available on our Academics page.
Email support is available at support@university.com.
Helpdesk is available 9AM to 6PM on working days.
